# Screenshots

Reference renders of the four screens, at the 1280x720 design size, used in pull
request descriptions and issue threads.

They live under `.github/` on purpose. Godot's filesystem scan skips directories
whose name begins with a dot, so nothing in here is imported as a resource and
nothing in here can end up in the exported pack — the same reason `build/`
needs an explicit `.gdignore` and this folder does not.

Regenerated by hand rather than by CI: a headless run cannot draw, so these come
from the pinned editor rendering into a virtual display.

```
xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1280x720x24" .godot-sdk/bin/godot \
  --path . --rendering-driver opengl3 --resolution 1280x720 --script <capture script>
```

Two things to know when reading them. They are drawn by the editor binary, so
`OS.is_debug_build()` is true and `play.png` shows the score column dropped
below the grime board's corner toggle — in a release build it sits at the top
margin. And they are quantised to a 256-colour palette to keep the repository
small, which dithers the sky and the tarmac but leaves the type exact, since
the type is what they are here to show.
